start_themes.name: Tyranny
start_themes.trigger_raw: A favor casually cast down can lift the weak from the mire. A casually spoken promise can fester into twisted hatred.\nNo reason needed, no fairness required. Your every whim is the law of Tartarus today.
start_themes.trigger_text: A favor casually cast down can lift the weak from the mire. A casually spoken promise can fester into twisted hatred. No reason needed, no fairness required. Your every whim is the law of Tartarus today.
start_themes.effect_raw: <RichText>Automatically triggers </><RichText Id="100030" Udl="1" HyperLinkType="1" EventId="16000108">Instigate</><RichText> and </><RichText Id="100030" Udl="1" HyperLinkType="1" EventId="16000109">Bestow</><RichText> 3 additional times each time you stop at the Interrogation Room</>
start_themes.effect_text: Automatically triggers Instigate and Bestow 3 additional times each time you stop at the Interrogation Room

start_themes.name: Opulence
start_themes.trigger_raw: Dazzling rings reflect insatiable desire. Raised golden goblets brim with swaying rot. Beneath these high walls, the banquet never ends.\nAll the treasures of Tartarus exist for you.
start_themes.trigger_text: Dazzling rings reflect insatiable desire. Raised golden goblets brim with swaying rot. Beneath these high walls, the banquet never ends. All the treasures of Tartarus exist for you.
start_themes.effect_raw: <RichText>You can make 2 additional choices when obtaining </><RichText Id="100030" Udl="1" HyperLinkType="1" EventId="16000118">Warden's Treasure</>
start_themes.effect_text: You can make 2 additional choices when obtaining Warden's Treasure

start_themes.name: Iron Law
start_themes.trigger_raw: Harsher iron laws, more brutal punishments. When agony is drawn out, when your name is carved and defaced over and over again.\nTell me, Warden, will this be a sweeter torment?
start_themes.trigger_text: Harsher iron laws, more brutal punishments. When agony is drawn out, when your name is carved and defaced over and over again. Tell me, Warden, will this be a sweeter torment?
start_themes.effect_raw: Extends the duration of the current run to 30 days
start_themes.effect_text: Extends the duration of the current run to 30 days

start_themes.name: Cage Fight
start_themes.trigger_raw: With your own hand, you unshackled the last chain of Tartarus, feeding the weak to the strong.\nFlesh scatters, hatred thrives. The malice bred beneath these high walls howls and thrashes as it turns on its one true master.\nWarden, bring victory to Tartarus.
